name: KENT Automatic Sand Filter-100 L
summary: KENT Automatic Sand Filter – 100L is a fully automatic whole-house filtration system designed to remove visible dirt, sand particles, and suspended impurities (turbidity) from river and borewell water.
intro: The KENT Automatic Sand Filter – 100L is a high-capacity, fully automatic pre-filtration system designed to remove visible suspended impurities such as sand, silt, mud, rust particles, and turbidity from water before it enters the household plumbing network. Suitable for whole-house water filtration, it is ideal for homes, villas, apartments, farmhouses, commercial establishments, and institutions that receive water from river, borewell, or municipal sources containing high levels of physical contaminants.|
features: Advanced 3-Step Filtration System for efficient removal of suspended impurities
100L filter media capacity for high-volume filtration
High flow rate of up to 4000 L/hr for uninterrupted whole-house water supply
Removes sand, silt, mud, rust particles, and suspended solids (turbidity)
Fully automatic regeneration with intelligent backwash operation
Smart LCD control panel for easy monitoring and operation
Reduces maintenance through automated cleaning cycles
Protects pipelines, storage tanks, plumbing fixtures, and household appliances
Improves the performance and lifespan of downstream water treatment systems
Compact floor-standing design for convenient installation

rows: Removal of visible dirt, sand, suspended matter and turbidity from water
River Water, Borewell Water, Municipal Water

This automatic sand filtration system is an ideal first-stage water treatment solution for applications requiring high flow rates and effective removal of suspended impurities before further purification or household distribution.
